card.fires_on: Words in warnings about symptoms being noticed, recognized or appearing, such as 'warning' in 'early warning symptoms', 'awareness' after 'Symptomatic', or 'whether' after 'determine'. It fires most in hypoglycemia and adverse-event warning text.
